universal_guidelines: DO NOT use gradients for text unless it's a very subtle white-to-grey.
Ensure all interactive elements have hover states (scale, color shift, or glow).
Use 'Unbounded' font for all Headings (H1-H3). Use 'Manrope' for body.
Primary Color #FF4500 is for high-priority actions only. Do not overuse.
instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the landing page using React + Tailwind. Use the provided image URLs. Ensure the 'Unbounded' font is imported in index.css. Use 'framer-motion' for entrance animations. The contact form is a redirect, not a backend submission.
